name: Create interview
description: Starts a new knowledge-retention interview for the caller in the chosen language. Refuses server-side if the caller already has an open interview.

inputFields.label: Interview language
inputFields.description: Language the interview is conducted in. Pass the English name of the language (e.g. "English", "German", "Chinese", "French", "Spanish", "Portuguese", "Japanese", "Italian", "Dutch") or its two-letter code ("en", "de", "zh", "fr", "es", "pt", "ja"). Any language the interviewee chooses or types is supported. The backend stores it and every later instruction is rendered in this language.
